user-prompt-submit-hook.description: Run linters with auto-fix before each Claude Code operation
args: echo '🔍 Running linters with auto-fix...' && npm run lint:fix:all || (echo '❌ Linting failed! Please fix errors before proceeding.' && exit 1)

edit-hook.description: Run linters with auto-fix after editing TypeScript/JavaScript files
args: echo '🔍 Running TypeScript linter with auto-fix...' && npm run lint:ts:fix || (echo '❌ TypeScript linting failed!' && exit 1)

edit-python-hook.description: Run Python linters with auto-fix after editing Python files
args: echo '🔍 Running Python linters with auto-fix...' && cd scripts && ./venv/bin/ruff check . --fix && ./venv/bin/mypy . || (echo '❌ Python linting/type-checking failed!' && exit 1)
